name: China Harzone Industry Corp., Ltd
summary: China Harzone Industry Corp., Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sales of emergency traffic engineering equipment in China and internationally. It offers emergency traffic equipment, such as road equipment series for highways, waterways, aviation, and railway emergency traffics. The company also provides emergency rescue disposal equipment, including medical vehicles, high-power long-distance water supply and drainage special vehicles, squad and power cars, command vehicles, snowplow, office vehicles, emergency rescue disposal, emergency rescue obstacle-crossing passage, and HZ-sand-throwing emergency vehicles and launch vehicles.
